summary: Executed mandatory post-fix retest on local worker http://127.0.0.1:8787. Backend SEO/policy suites passed (7/7). Across 3 independent browser runs on /compare, rapid selection consistently kept exactly 3 items and rejected the 4th, but Compare ended in a silent no-result state (no compare-loading-status completion to compare-results and no compare-error). Non-compare product/detail/gallery/contact RFQ flows passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Deterministic failure across 3 independent runs: after selecting 3 products and attempting 4th (properly rejected), clicking Compare produced neither compare-results nor compare-error (silent no-result state).

integration_issues.flow: Compare selection -> Compare submit -> side-by-side results
integration_issues.issue: No live /api/products/compare request was observed in browser run traces when compare-submit was clicked; no loading completion, no results, and no error message rendered.
product_compare_add was not duplicated (3 events for 3 accepted selections), but an unexpected product_compare_remove event appeared before/around Compare click in each failed run.

issues: Persistent cookie bar overlaps lower viewport content area and can reduce visibility of lower controls on first interaction.

action_items: Fix CompareWorkspace to guarantee explicit terminal state after Compare click: either compare-results or compare-error; silent state must be impossible.
Trace why compare-submit click path can emit product_compare_remove and avoid compare API invocation under rapid-selection conditions.
After compare fix, rerun full compare acceptance chain (side-by-side specs, differences-only, print, remove, clear, refresh persistence, and comparison-to-RFQ exact product-code carry-over).
critical_code_review_comments: compare-workspace.tsx remains heavily minified into one-line component logic, which significantly reduces debuggability for interaction race conditions.
compare() correctly reads selectedRef.current, but current UX still allows a terminally ambiguous state from the user perspective (no success and no visible failure) under rapid interactions.
No MOCKED APIs were used; all checks were against live local worker endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 65% (core compare acceptance blocked; product/detail/gallery/contact flows passed)

seed_data_creation: Submitted one contact lead via UI using qa.iter157.rerun@brightluxx-example.test for integration verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not spend additional selector retries on compare preconditions: these already pass consistently (3 chips persist, 4th rejected). Focus directly on compare-submit execution path and why no /api/products/compare network call is emitted in browser despite endpoint being healthy via direct POST.
rca of the issue: Reproduction (3/3): open /compare -> type BL -> rapidly click four options -> exactly three chips remain and max notice appears -> click compare-submit. Expected: transient compare-loading-status then compare-results, or visible compare-error with HTTP failure context. Actual: silent no-result state with neither compare-results nor compare-error. API health validated separately (POST /api/products/compare returns 200). Probable root area is compare submit interaction path/state transition in CompareWorkspace under rapid selection/dropdown state.
